interval_years.quote: each individual licensed public adjuster shall submit biennially to the Commission a renewal application ... shall, unless the license has been terminated, suspended, or revoked be renewed for a two-year period.

required.quote: Every individual resident and nonresident public adjuster shall, on a biennial basis, furnish evidence as set forth in this article that the continuing education requirements of this article have been satisfied.

hours_per_period.quote: A public adjuster shall complete 24 hours of relevant continuing education credits.

period_years.quote: Every individual resident and nonresident public adjuster shall, on a biennial basis, furnish evidence as set forth in this article that the continuing education requirements of this article have been satisfied.

topical_requirements.quote: Of the total required credits for each biennium, a public adjuster shall complete three credit hours in insurance ethics.

available.quote: An individual or business entity that is not a resident as defined in subsection B of § 38.2-1800.1 but that is a resident of another state, territory, or province of Canada shall receive a nonresident public adjuster license if:

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed as a resident public adjuster in good standing in their home state; submit proper application and fees; home state must issue nonresident licenses to VA residents on the same basis or permit VA residents to act without a license; must maintain a $50,000 surety bond; business entities must obtain certificate of authority from the Clerk of the Commission.
requirements.quote: The applicant presents proof in a form acceptable to the Commission that the applicant is currently licensed or otherwise authorized as a resident public adjuster and is in good standing in his home state

credential_type.quote: "License" means a document issued by the Commission authorizing an individual or business entity to act as a public adjuster.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the business of public adjusting without first applying for and obtaining a license from the Commission

title_protection.quote: No person except a public adjuster duly licensed under this article shall: ... Advertise for employment as a public adjuster

scope_protection.quote: No person except a public adjuster duly licensed under this article shall: 1. Accept a commission, fee, or other compensation for investigating or settling claims; 2. Prepare, complete, or file an insurance claim on behalf of an insured; 3. Aid or act on behalf of an insured in negotiating for or effecting the settlement of a claim for loss or damage covered by an insurance contract

bonding_required.quote: Prior to issuance of a license, each applicant shall attest that the applicant has, and thereafter shall keep in force for as long as the license remains in effect, a bond in favor of the Commonwealth in the amount of $50,000 with corporate sureties licensed by the Commission

definition_quote.value: "Public adjusting" means soliciting, investigating, negotiating, adjusting, or providing advice to an insured in relation to first party claims arising under insurance contracts that insure the real or personal property of an insured for the purpose of effecting the settlement of a claim on behalf of the insured.
definition_quote.quote: "Public adjusting" means soliciting, investigating, negotiating, adjusting, or providing advice to an insured in relation to first party claims arising under insurance contracts that insure the real or personal property of an insured for the purpose of effecting the settlement of a claim on behalf of the insured.

methods_authorized.quote: "Public adjusting" means soliciting, investigating, negotiating, adjusting, or providing advice to an insured in relation to first party claims arising under insurance contracts that insure the real or personal property of an insured for the purpose of effecting the settlement of a claim on behalf of the insured.

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: A business entity acting as a public adjuster is required to obtain a public adjuster license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated an individual employee, officer, director, manager, member, or partner licensed in Virginia as a public adjuster to be responsible for the business entity's compliance with the laws, rules, and regulations of the Commonwealth applicable to public adjusters.

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: An individual or business entity that is not a resident as defined in subsection B of § 38.2-1800.1 but that is a resident of another state, territory, or province of Canada shall receive a nonresident public adjuster license

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: Each individual applicant for a public adjuster license shall, at the time of applying for a new license, be fingerprinted in a form and manner prescribed by the Commission and shall provide personal descriptive information to be forwarded along with the applicant's fingerprints through the Central Criminal Records Exchange to the Federal Bureau of Investigation for the purpose of obtaining criminal history record information regarding such applicant.

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: No public adjuster shall have a financial interest in any aspect of an insured's claim other than the salary, fee, commission, or compensation that may be established in the written contract between the insured and the public adjuster. For the purposes of this subsection, "financial interest" includes participation by a public adjuster, directly or indirectly, in the reconstruction, repair, or restoration of damaged property that is the subject of a claim adjusted by that public adjuster.

surety_bond_required.quote: Prior to issuance of a license, each applicant shall attest that the applicant has, and thereafter shall keep in force for as long as the license remains in effect, a bond in favor of the Commonwealth in the amount of $50,000 with corporate sureties licensed by the Commission

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: a bond in favor of the Commonwealth in the amount of $50,000 with corporate sureties licensed by the Commission

written_contract_required.quote: Public adjusters shall ensure that all contracts for their services are in writing and contain the following terms:

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: The right to rescind the contract within three business days after the contract has been signed by the insured or, in the event of a catastrophic disaster, the right to rescind the contract within five business days after the contract has been signed by the insured.

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: No public adjuster shall refer or direct an insured needing repairs or other services in connection with a loss to any person in which the public adjuster has an ownership interest nor to any person who will or is reasonably anticipated to provide the public adjuster with any direct or indirect compensation for the referral of any resulting business.

prohibited_claim_types.quote: public adjusting does not include acting in any manner in relation to liability claims for personal injury or property damage, other third-party claims, or uninsured or underinsured bodily injury liability claims.

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: No public adjuster shall enter into a contract or accept a power of attorney that vests in the public adjuster the effective authority to choose the persons who shall perform repair work.

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: No public adjuster shall solicit or attempt to solicit a client during the progress of a loss producing occurrence as covered by the insurance contract.
